# PLLM

- [Inspect configuration and components](https://pllm.run/cli/inspect-and-research/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli/inspect-and-research.md)): Validate public experiment data and inspect built-in component records.
- [Run private inference](https://pllm.run/cli/private-inference/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli/private-inference.md)): Run the trusted gateway locally or connect it to independently operated PLLM roles.
- [Operate provider roles](https://pllm.run/cli/provider-roles/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli/provider-roles.md)): Start authenticated inference and preparation services without exposing application APIs.
